surfaces.name: CLI
surfaces.purpose: Developer engine, Claude Code-compatible terminal workflow, local/BYOK session foundation
allowedImports: packages only through generated/protocol boundaries when explicit

surfaces.name: Desktop
surfaces.stack: Tauri v2, React, Vite, Rust backend
surfaces.purpose: Local-first private compute host, artifacts, MCP/connectors, computer use, local files

surfaces.name: Web
surfaces.purpose: Account, projects, synced app chats, artifacts, billing/waitlist, admin

surfaces.name: Mobile
surfaces.purpose: Small Local LLM mobile app, Cloud invite/waitlist, continuity, capture, approvals, preview/download/share

surfaces.name: Chrome Extension
surfaces.purpose: Browser context, capture, research/action, native messaging bridge

surfaces.name: VS Code Extension
surfaces.purpose: IDE-native developer surface and agent session UI

surfaces.name: Sandbox
surfaces.stack: Static HTML (single index.html, no build step), deployed to sandbox.agiworkforce.com via Vercel
surfaces.purpose: Cross-origin artifact renderer — sandboxed iframe/srcDoc rendering of generated artifacts and file previews with download-safety isolation (see risk-map artifact-rendering)
allowedImports: none — isolated static renderer; receives content via postMessage only

platform.name: TypeScript packages
platform.purpose: Shared contracts, provider adapters, runtime helpers, UI packages, local tools
platform.rule: Packages must not import from apps.

platform.name: Rust crates
platform.purpose: Reusable Rust protocol, command registry, sandbox, task, plugin, and utility crates
platform.rule: Reusable runtime belongs in crates only when there is a second consumer.

platform.name: Services
platform.purpose: API gateway, signaling server, future managed compute services
platform.rule: Services must not import UI packages.

platform.name: Database
platform.purpose: Canonical Neon migrations and database docs
primaryChecks: review migrations manually before billing/security changes

platform.name: Enterprise Control Plane
platform.purpose: Admin policy, identity, audit, support, usage ledger, managed-credit launch gates, and enterprise docs
platform.rule: Managed compute remains private beta until ledger, caps, fraud, refund, dispute, and provider-term gates are proven.
